videos.description:
Palantir & Databricks: powering end-to-end data, analytics, and operational AI. 

Chad Wahlquist and Benjamin Abood discuss how the Data Intelligence Platform, Unity Catalog, Foundry, and AIP all seamlessly integrate to deliver next-generation outcomes.

videos.title: AIP 2026: The Self-Healing Autonomous Enterprise | Paragon 2025
videos.description:
"Ontology allows us to break out of the local optima and monitor the enterprise at scale - where disparate data sources, unique processes and siloed teams made this previously impossible."

Palantir is the operating system for mission-critical decision making, with the world’s foremost organizations running agentic operations across the fabric of the business, via their own unique Ontology. Watch as Palantir Head of AI Go-To-Market Jack Dobson presents the latest of AIP at Paragon 2025, focused on human-AI teaming, enterprise autonomy and operational process optimization.

videos.title: Alex Karp Opening Remarks | Paragon 2025
videos.description: Watch as Palantir CEO Alex Karp opens Paragon 2025 with remarks on the original patriotism that fuels Palantir philosophy today.

videos.title: Actionable Intelligence from Every Tenant Interaction | Healthpeak at Paragon 2025
videos.description:
"It's a platform that will learn from every interaction... and ultimately gets back to our goal of delivering the best tenant experience for our partners."

Watch as Healthpeak Chief Investment Officer Adam G. Mabry showcases how they utilize AIP and the Ontology to trigger automated workflows for leasing opportunities, maintenance issues, and capital allocation decisions — enabling property managers to leave the office and focus on their tenants.

videos.title: Preventing Payer Denials in Healthcare | R1 RCM at Paragon 2025
videos.description:
"It's not replacing humans, it empowers them. The agent handles the tedious work of gathering all this data so the specialists can focus on the high value decision.”

Watch as R1 RCM Executive Vice President & Chief Product Officer Steve Albert and Senior Vice President of Engineering for R37 Jon Katzur demo how Phare OS enables medical billing teams to move from automated payer denial handling to preventing denials altogether.

videos.title: Why Every Other Software Must Justify Its Existence | Thomas Cavanagh at Paragon 2025
videos.description:
"We've gone all in so much so that every other software must justify its existence. And so far they haven't been able to. 97% of our employees use Foundry every day. Foundry is our operating system.”

 Watch as Thomas Cavanagh AI Lead Joe Patrois showcases Total Operations Management — a replacement for all other scheduling software — and Site 360 Daily Reporting, enabling employees to allocate hours and equipment across cost codes in seconds rather than hours.

videos.title: Customized Care When You Need it Most | Tampa General Hospital at Paragon 2025
videos.description:
“We use a Palantir algorithm to pick sepsis up earlier and get patients on a treatment pathway. It’s resulted in a 68% reduction in 48 hour mortality... in the last two years, that's resulted in 700 additional patients being able to leave the hospital.”

Watch as Tampa General Hospital Senior Vice President & Chief Transformation Officer Dr. Peter Chang demos Modern Hospital OS — the Foundry-built operating system that customizes care for their patients.
